pages.text: It was midday. The sun stood overhead. The heat had made the village quiet.
"Let's build a shade hut!" Taro gathered branches. "I'll bring big leaves!" Mumu bounded away.
Taro stood up the branches. One, two, three. He tied their tops together.
But Mumu did not come. Taro laid small leaves on by himself. "Are the leaves that far away?"
Mumu reached the place where big leaves grew. It was very cool underneath. Holding some leaves, Mumu lay down for a moment.
The shade hut was finished. Taro tried sitting inside alone. "It's no fun by myself. I'll find Mumu."
Taro went behind the hut. Right there, big leaves hung down, casting deep shade.
Mumu lay beneath them, fast asleep, still holding the big leaves.
Taro did not wake Mumu. He covered them with one more leaf and quietly lay down beside them.
They slept side by side. The new shade hut stood empty. A chicken went in and sat down.
